vectors.name: approval-mode-sets
vectors.note: approval mode. owner: authority with a membership; mona: authority without one (authority does not depend on it); alice: membership + grant; bob: membership only (an applicant); carol: grant only; dave: membership + ban; erin: ban only. P = A ∪ {member ∧ access ≠ none}; S = (A ∪ G) ∖ (B ∪ N); authorities are never listed as applicants (NOTES.md)

vectors.name: open-mode-sets
vectors.note: the same records in open mode: P = A ∪ members; there are no applicants; newcomers = P ∖ (S ∪ E) with E = S here (no opinions). dave is banned but still a participant: V4 hides his content

vectors.name: keep-overrides-a-ban-in-approval-mode
vectors.note: a banned member is still a participant in approval mode (access ≠ none), so an item-level keep at rank ≥ banRank keeps his post visible; his other post is Hidden(Banned)

vectors.name: nullify-removes-from-seeds
vectors.note: #restrict{nullifyVotes: true} puts alice in N: she leaves S (and E) but stays granted and a participant; nullify hides nothing

vectors.name: grant-against-ban-by-rank
vectors.note: a higher rank's #access{member} overrides a ban and also grants (alice becomes a seed); at equal rank the ban wins (banned < member)

vectors.name: grant-by-a-former-moderator-lapses
vectors.note: mona is no longer listed, so her grant lapses at once: alice is an applicant again and her content is Hidden(NotParticipant)

vectors.name: leaving-keeps-the-grant
vectors.note: alice deleted her membership record: V2 hides her content (not a participant) but the grant still counts, so she remains a seed

vectors.name: moderators-entry-rules
vectors.note: FO2: the owner's own entry and an unknown role are ignored, and the first entry for a DID wins even when it is itself ignored (mona's 'superuser' entry), so mona is no authority; adam's later 'moderator' entry is ignored

vectors.name: membership-absent-defaults-to-approval
vectors.note: an absent membership field takes the lexicon default, approval (alice is an applicant)

vectors.name: unknown-membership-falls-back-to-approval

vectors.name: banned-authority-keeps-its-authority
